# @three-ws/assistant

> A 3D avatar assistant for any website in one script tag. A floating launcher opens a real animated avatar with a chatbot mode (free models or the visitor's own Groq/OpenRouter key) and a speak mode that says whatever you type, out loud, in a speech bubble.

@three-ws/assistant is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npm install @three-ws/assistant`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-assistant/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-assistant/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-assistant/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-assistant/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
